death.note: Undated, and the honest word for it. He was carried as 'before the 11th century', which is a bound on when he was written down and not on when he lived: the one record of him, Sinai Codex 631, is of the tenth or eleventh century. No source names a century, and an interval running from the apostolic age to that codex is not a date.
